arguments.value: Summary: UTEK Corporation agreed to act as an independent contractor for World Energy Solutions for 12 months (unless ended sooner), helping identify and review technology acquisition opportunities from universities and government labs, maintain confidentiality, and, if requested and mutually agreed, help negotiate licenses or related financing plans. In return, World Energy Solutions was to pay UTEK with company stock under the attached term sheet, with shares vesting monthly and unvested shares returned if the deal ended early. Each side covered its own expenses. The agreement also required both parties to follow securities and disclosure rules, kept shared information confidential, limited employee solicitation for 24 months, allowed termination on 30 days’ notice, and included indemnity, assignment, notice, injunctive relief, and attorneys’ fees provisions.
